_help: Your own apps that Lite Phone > Settings > Updates can update. One entry per app: name, package (its applicationId), repo (owner/name), and either path (an APK committed in the repo's default branch) or asset (the APK's file name on the repo's latest release). Private repos need a read-only GitHub token saved in the Updates screen. This list only covers updates; whether an app may open is still set in Add or remove apps.
